{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
conversion_errors = sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum()

# Check the total sum after conversion
total_revenue_clean = sales_df['revenue'].sum()

(conversion_errors, total_revenue_clean)"}
